citations.short: Establish reliability of supplier's C of A
citations.long: Establishment of the reliability of the component supplier's report of analyses is deficient in that the test results are not appropriately validated at appropriate intervals.

Laboratory controls do not include the establishment of scientifically sound and appropriate test procedures designed to assure that in-process materials conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality and purity.

The batch production and control records do not include a statement of the actual yield and percentage of theoretical yield at appropriate stages of processing for each batch of drug product produced.
Employees are not given training in the particular operations they perform as part of their function.
There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
Adverse drug experience information has not been reported to FDA.
Not all adverse drug experiences that are both serious and unexpected have been reported to FDA within 15 calendar days of initial receipt of the information.

An NDA-Field Alert Report was not submitted within three working days of receipt of information concerning a failure of one or more distributed batches of a drug to meet the specifications established for it in the application.

citations.short: Mfg and control changes not requiring a supplemental app.
citations.long: An annual report did not include a full description of the manufacturing and control changes not requiring a supplemental application, listed by date in the order in which they were implemented.

citations.short: Items to cover on annual reviews
citations.long: Written procedures are not established for evaluations done at least annually and including provisions for a review of complaints, recalls, returned or salvaged drug products, and investigations conducted for each drug product.

citations.short: Records of disposition of rejected material
citations.long: Records do not include the disposition of rejected drug product containers.
